related_artifact_links.rationale: The invitation procedure presupposes the organization-owned developer account required for App Factory publishing.
The procedure implements the documented requirement to invite App Factory and grant publishing access.
Granting App Factory access does not transfer the organization's ongoing responsibility for its developer account.

artifact.retrieval_text: App Factory can be invited through Apple App Store Connect by adding its documented identity, assigning the Admin role and selecting the applicable app scope.
artifact.title: App Factory can be invited through Apple App Store Connect.

review_notes: Documentation revision `1.0.0` was treated as documentation metadata rather than Rock product-version scope.
The standalone `Note` and `Warning` labels were excluded because they convey no independently useful information without their adjacent units.
The general statement that the App Factory team will provide details was excluded because it does not supply durable operational detail.

The invitation prerequisite in source unit `source-unit:372d64d5ffcf805be9ab71a7465008ea` was not emitted separately because the more specific prerequisite in source unit `source-unit:7bfb35b7ecef867e66305a5aa2318574` already preserves its practical meaning.

artifact.independent_question: How does an organization invite App Factory through Google Play Console?

cautions: The documented `Admin (all permissions)` selection grants broad access.
The source documents either app-level access to the existing app being replaced or account-level access.
Verify the current email address, controls, permission names and intended scope before sending the invitation.
payload.completion_or_use: The procedure is complete when the user invitation has been submitted to `mobile@rockappfactory.com` with the selected documented administrative scope.
implementation_elements: An organization-controlled Google Play Console account.
The App Factory invitation email `mobile@rockappfactory.com`.

steps.instruction: Sign in to the Google Play Console.
Select `Invite new users`.
Enter `mobile@rockappfactory.com` and grant either `Admin (all permissions)` app permissions for the existing app being replaced or `Admin (all permissions)` account permissions.
Select `Invite User`.
